= Modifier order(1)
:doctype: manpage
:manmanual: Test Manual
:mansource: acdc
:revdate: 2026-10-07
:value: *bold*
:empty:
:link: link:https://example.org[Link]

== Name

modifier-order - incremental substitution order

== Description

[subs="attributes+"]
S01 {value}.

[subs="+attributes"]
S02 {value}.

[subs="-attributes,+attributes"]
S03 {value}.

[subs="attributes+"]
S04 `{empty}`.

[subs="attributes+"]
S05 *bold{sp}*.

[subs="attributes+,normal+"]
S06 `{empty}`.

[subs="normal+,attributes+"]
S07 {value}.

[subs="attributes+,attributes+"]
S08 {value}.

[subs="attributes+,quotes+"]
S09 *source* {value}.

[subs="quotes+,attributes+"]
S10 *source* {value}.

[subs="attributes+,verbatim+"]
S11 {value}.

[source,text,subs="normal+"]
----
S12 {value}.
----

[source,text,subs="normal+,attributes+"]
----
S13 {value}.
----

[source,text,subs="+normal"]
----
S14 {value}.
----

[subs="attributes+"]
S15 {link}.

[subs="macros+,attributes+"]
S16 {link}.

[subs="attributes+,macros+"]
S17 {link}.

[source,text,subs="attributes+,+quotes"]
----
S18 `{empty}` *café{sp}*.
----

[subs="attributes+,-attributes"]
S19 {value}.

[subs="-quotes,attributes+"]
S20 {value}.
